correctness.rationale: Let v_i=alpha^(q^(is)), i mod N, N=2m. Since gcd(s,N)=1 these N rows form a K-basis. Ho Lemma 4.1 gives S0=lambda^-1 nonzero and S_r=0 for r≠0. Thus <v_i,v_j>_e is nonzero exactly when j=i−t mod N, t=e*s^{-1} mod N. The right orthogonal complement of span v_0..v_(k−1) is the complementary interval [k−t,...,N−1−t], the left complement [k+t,...,N−1+t]. Intersection with original interval has k−max(0,k−min(t,N−t))=min(k,min(t,N−t)) independent of orientation for k≤N/2. Endpoints e=0 and e=N/2 give LCD and Hermitian self-orthogonal; at k=m the latter is self-dual. Independent interval exhaustions N even up to 44, all units s, k,e; actual artifacts/verify.py also checks F9 scaled basis.
risk: Finite cyclic-index tests are not proofs of Moore-basis or correlation premise; validity requires scaled trace-self-dual basis and full length N.
